title: Capitalism as the base of the American dream
summary: Rose agrees capitalism gave individuals opportunity until about the 1890s.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, relating this back to the music again, do you see, then, the capitalist system as part of the American dream, which was valid at this point? Oh, yes, of course. Maybe until 1890s or something like that. Certainly.
The capitalist system, as it operated in America, still provided, certainly provided, an enormous amount of opportunity for individuals to be able to function independently.
